title: Evaluating cross-dataset transfer learning for photoplethysmography-based blood pressure estimation
topics: PPG | cuffless BP | cross-dataset transfer | personalization
model_method: Compact BP-CRNN pretrained on a source dataset; last convolutional and fully connected layers are fine-tuned with limited target-subject data.
main_results: Cross-dataset personalization on 200 patients achieved SBP/DBP MAE 3.36/1.81 mmHg, about 13% better than no transfer; external wearable-domain errors remained around SBP 10.5–10.9 and DBP 6.9 mmHg in the prior review.
study_goal_zh: 检验一个在医院数据上训练的 PPG→BP 模型，能否用少量目标用户数据迁移到新数据集和真实可穿戴场景。
method_summary_zh: 先在源数据集预训练轻量 BP-CRNN，再只微调最后的卷积层和全连接层，用少量目标用户的 PPG 与参考 BP 完成个体化。
result_summary_zh: 在 200 名目标患者的个体化实验中，SBP/DBP MAE 为 3.36/1.81 mmHg，比不做迁移约改善 13%；到了外部可穿戴数据，误差升至约 10.5–10.9/6.9 mmHg。
conclusion_summary_zh: 跨数据集迁移和个体化确实有帮助，但医院数据上的好成绩不能直接代表可穿戴场景；真实域差异仍然很大。
takeaway_zh: 可用于需要入组校准的个体化方案，不能当作免校准、跨人群通用模型。
deployment_summary_zh: 上线前需要用户提供少量 PPG+参考 BP 做微调；之后单次推理只需 PPG 和已保存的个体参数。
leakage_summary_zh: 未发现推理时使用当前测试 BP；主要风险是同一用户的校准窗口与测试窗口过近，造成个体化结果偏乐观。
calibration_notes: Needs limited target-user PPG with reference BP.
subject_split_notes: Evaluation is organized by target subjects; source and target datasets are distinct.
deployment_notes: Personal reference BP is required before deployment, not for each prediction.
abp_bp_denormalization: not reported as current-test target dependent
abp_bp_alignment: dataset synchronization used; no per-window target alignment confirmed
abp_bp_windowing: reference BP used to create supervised target windows
abp_bp_quality_filtering: quality filtering present; exact target dependence needs protocol audit
target_dependent_calibration: historical target-subject BP used for fine-tuning
window_leakage: controlled by subject-specific protocol but temporal proximity remains a concern
subject_leakage: not the primary risk; evaluation is personalized by design
leakage_notes: Strong deployment relevance, but personalized results cannot be read as calibration-free cross-person generalization.
notes: 重点深审。

title: Few-Shot Personalized Blood Pressure Estimation from Photoplethysmography and Physiological Priors via Low-Rank Adaptation
source_venue: IEEE Journal of Biomedical and Health Informatics
topics: PPG | cuffless BP | personalization | LoRA | physiological prior
datasets: UCI Cuffless BP | University of Queensland | CAS-BP
model_method: Population-pretrained Transformer personalized with sampling-rate-robust LoRA (SRR-LoRA) and pulse-pressure consistency loss.
main_results: Reported SBP MAE 1.52 mmHg and DBP MAE 1.07 mmHg after few-shot personalization; 2,405 pretraining subjects and 316 personalization subjects were described in the prior daily review.
study_goal_zh: 用少量个人样本，把群体 PPG→BP 模型快速适配到新用户，同时尽量减少需要更新的参数量。
method_summary_zh: 先训练群体 Transformer，再用 SRR-LoRA 做低秩个体化，并加入 pulse pressure 一致性损失；个人适配只更新少量 LoRA 参数。
result_summary_zh: 论文报告个体化后 SBP/DBP MAE 为 1.52/1.07 mmHg；此前日报记录的预训练人群为 2,405 人，个体化实验为 316 人。
conclusion_summary_zh: Few-shot LoRA 能显著提高同一用户上的预测精度，但高精度依赖个人标注样本，不能表述为“无需校准”。
takeaway_zh: 工程上有吸引力，但必须把个人 cuff BP 的采集成本和校准—测试时间间隔写清楚。
deployment_summary_zh: 完成入组校准后可仅用 PPG 推理；生成个人 LoRA adapter 时仍需要带参考 BP 的个人样本。
leakage_summary_zh: 未发现当前测试 BP 进入推理；需继续核对个人校准窗口与测试窗口是否严格分离。
calibration_notes: Requires labeled personal PPG/BP examples; exact shot count varies by experiment and is not safely reduced here to a single number.
subject_split_notes: Personalization cohorts are subject-based; exact train/validation/test protocol still needs full-text table verification.
external_validation_notes: Multiple datasets used, but no clearly independent external clinical validation was confirmed.
deployment_notes: Deployment can be PPG-only after onboarding, but cuff/reference BP is needed to create the personalized adapter.
target_dependent_calibration: historical personal BP labels used for onboarding
subject_leakage: lower risk if reported subject protocol is followed
leakage_notes: No evidence that current test BP is needed at inference; personalization can still make same-person evaluation optimistic if calibration/test windows are too close.
notes: 重点深审；不要把“少样本个体化”误写成“无需校准”。

title: Feasibility and performance evaluation of PPG on a Galaxy Watch in continuous central blood pressure monitoring
topics: PPG | Galaxy Watch | central BP | change tracking | external prospective validation
datasets: 6117 measurements/440 development participants | 114 catheterization validation participants
input_signals: Galaxy Watch 6 PPG | optional baseline calibration
model_method: PPG algorithm detects relative MAP/SBP/DBP changes against invasive central aortic BP; prospective catheterization evaluation.
main_results: For ≥15% MAP increase AUC 0.85; MAP-change correlation r=0.92 with bias 0.51 mmHg; median detection delay 1 min; uncalibrated change detection remained robust.
study_goal_zh: 验证 Galaxy Watch 的腕部 PPG 能否连续追踪中心动脉 BP 的相对变化，而不是只在静息时给出一个绝对 BP 数字。
method_summary_zh: 算法从手表 PPG 提取 MAP/SBP/DBP 的变化，并在导管检查人群中与侵入式中心主动脉 BP 做前瞻性比较；同时比较有、无基线校准。
result_summary_zh: 识别 MAP 上升≥15% 的 AUC 为 0.85；MAP 变化相关系数 r=0.92，偏差 0.51 mmHg，中位检测延迟 1 分钟；无校准时变化检测仍较稳健。
conclusion_summary_zh: 腕部 PPG 很适合做 ΔBP/MAP 趋势追踪，但这项研究并未证明手表可按完整标准输出可靠的绝对 BP。
takeaway_zh: 把它理解为“变化报警器”比“电子血压计”更准确。
deployment_summary_zh: 推理只需腕部 PPG，可选基线；适合趋势监测，不应外推为绝对 BP 产品验证。
leakage_summary_zh: 开发与前瞻性验证队列分开，未见当前参考 BP 输入模型；侵入式 BP 仅用于评价。
calibration_type: baseline calibration optional for change tracking
calibration_notes: Calibrated and uncalibrated relative-change analyses were both reported.
subject_split_notes: Development and prospective evaluation cohorts are separate.
external_validation_notes: Reference is invasive central aortic BP.
deployment_judgment: 适合 ΔBP/MAP 变化检测，非绝对 BP 产品验证
deployment_notes: Protocol did not satisfy all relevant validation requirements.
abp_bp_alignment: minute-level paired reference used for evaluation
leakage_notes: Reference BP defines outcomes but is not needed by deployed PPG model.
notes: 重点深审。

title: Validation and Subgroup Analysis of the Accuracy of the Photoplethysmography-based Microlife Cuffless Upper-arm Wearable Blood Pressure Monitor
topics: PPG | cuffless BP | clinical validation | skin tone | age
model_method: Commercial upper-arm PPG cuffless monitor evaluated with sequential same-arm measurements under AAMI/ESH/ISO 81060-2:2018/Amd 1:2020.
main_results: 120 adults; met AAMI/ESH/ISO accuracy criteria and showed broadly consistent results across age and Fitzpatrick skin-tone groups.
study_goal_zh: 按医疗器械标准检验 Microlife 上臂式 PPG 无袖带血压计的准确性，并观察年龄和肤色亚组是否一致。
method_summary_zh: 在 120 名成人中采用同臂序贯测量，与参考 cuff BP 比较，并按 AAMI/ESH/ISO 81060-2:2018/Amd 1:2020 的要求评估。
result_summary_zh: 设备达到论文采用的 AAMI/ESH/ISO 准确性判据；年龄与 Fitzpatrick 肤色亚组结果总体一致。
conclusion_summary_zh: 这是较接近产品验证的证据，但使用方式和校准条件仍需遵守研究协议，不能泛化到所有场景。
takeaway_zh: 比纯算法回顾性实验更接近真实产品证据，但仍要看校准、测量姿势和适用人群。
deployment_summary_zh: 适合校准后进行居家频繁测量；需要按设备说明完成初始校准。
leakage_summary_zh: 属于独立设备验证，不是随机窗口训练评估；主要关注校准流程与参考测量协议，而非模型窗口泄露。

subject_split_notes: Prospective measurement validation rather than model train/test split.
external_validation_notes: General adult population with subgroup analysis.
deployment_judgment: 临床验证较强但需要袖带校准
deployment_notes: Suitable for frequent home measurements after calibration.
subject_leakage: not applicable to prospective device validation
leakage_notes: Calibration is an authorized deployment input, not leakage, provided later reference readings are only evaluation targets.

title: Benchmarking and Enhancing PPG-Based Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation Methods
topics: PPG | cuffless BP | benchmark | demographics | clinical criteria
model_method: Standardized 101,453-segment benchmark from 1,103 healthy adults; compares multiple models and demographic fusion.
main_results: No baseline model met AAMI/ISO numerical limits; demographic-enhanced MInception reduced error 23% to SBP/DBP MAE 4.75/2.90 mmHg.
study_goal_zh: 在统一数据和评估流程下比较多种 PPG→BP 模型，避免不同论文因数据处理不同而无法公平比较。
method_summary_zh: 构建 1,103 名健康成人、101,453 个片段的统一基准，比较多种网络，并测试把人口学信息与 PPG 表征融合。
result_summary_zh: 所有基础模型都未达到 AAMI/ISO 的数值门槛；加入人口学信息后，MInception 误差下降 23%，SBP/DBP MAE 为 4.75/2.90 mmHg。
conclusion_summary_zh: 人口学信息能改善数值表现，但达到某个 MAE 门槛不等于完成医疗器械标准验证。
takeaway_zh: 这是模型公平比较的基准，不是产品合规证明。
deployment_summary_zh: 仍处研究基准阶段；推理可能需要 PPG 和人口学信息，尚无独立临床产品验证。
leakage_summary_zh: 重点要核对统一 benchmark 是否严格 subject-disjoint；数值达标不能替代标准规定的受试者级协议。
calibration_notes: Demographics are covariates, not cuff calibration.
subject_split_notes: Full split manifest should be preserved in reuse.
external_validation_notes: Derived from two public ICU/OR datasets, not consumer-device clinical validation.
deployment_judgment: 有助于公平比较，非产品验证
deployment_notes: Numerical standard thresholds alone do not establish protocol compliance.
abp_bp_quality_filtering: curation likely uses signal/physiological constraints; audit manifest needed
window_leakage: controlled by standardized protocol; verify implementation
leakage_notes: Healthy-adult subset and demographic baselines may narrow target variance.
notes: 重点深审。

title: AnyPPG: An ECG-Guided PPG Foundation Model Trained on Over 100,000 Hours of Recordings for Holistic Health Profiling
topics: PPG | foundation model | ECG-guided pretraining | wearable
input_signals: PPG at deployment | ECG only during pretraining
model_method: Dual-modal alignment places synchronized PPG and ECG representations in a shared physiological space; downstream use can retain only the PPG encoder.
main_results: Pretraining covers about 109,909 h from 58,796 subjects; reports average gains of 12.8% in regression and 9.1% in classification across 11 tasks.
study_goal_zh: 利用训练期同步 ECG 帮助 PPG 学到更稳定的生理表征，再把 PPG encoder 用到多种健康任务。
method_summary_zh: 通过跨模态对齐，让同步 PPG 与 ECG 进入共享生理空间；下游部署时可以只保留 PPG encoder。
result_summary_zh: 预训练规模约 109,909 小时、58,796 人；在 11 个任务上，回归平均提升 12.8%，分类平均提升 9.1%。
conclusion_summary_zh: ECG 可作为训练期的 privileged supervision 提升 PPG 表征，但 AnyPPG 本身不是专门的 BP 医疗器械验证。
takeaway_zh: 适合作为 PPG foundation model 底座；是否能测 BP 仍取决于下游数据、划分和临床验证。
deployment_summary_zh: 训练时需要 ECG 对齐监督，下游推理可以只用 PPG。
leakage_summary_zh: ECG 是训练监督而非测试目标；下游任务仍需重新审计 subject split 和 BP 标签使用方式。
calibration_notes: No cuff BP calibration protocol is established by the foundation-model paper.
subject_split_notes: Exact per-task split must be checked before BP claims.
external_validation_notes: Broad health tasks, not a dedicated cuffless BP device validation.

title: Arterial blood pressure waveform reconstruction estimation from PPG using TCN–BiLSTM
topics: PPG | ABP waveform reconstruction | cuffless BP | TCN | BiLSTM | target leakage
input_signals: PPG | first derivative PPG | second derivative PPG
model_method: 8 s PPG windows (2 s stride) are mapped to normalized ABP waveforms by a TCN–BiLSTM with extrema-aware Huber loss.
main_results: VitalDB reported SBP MAE/RMSE 3.61/5.24 and DBP 1.79/2.37 mmHg; external MIMIC-IV table reported about 4.6/1.9 mmHg MAE.
study_goal_zh: 只根据 PPG 重建完整 ABP 波形，并从波形中估计 SBP/DBP。
method_summary_zh: 将 8 秒 PPG 窗口（2 秒步长）送入 TCN–BiLSTM，预测归一化 ABP 波形，并用强调极值的 Huber loss 训练。
result_summary_zh: VitalDB 上 SBP MAE/RMSE 为 3.61/5.24 mmHg，DBP 为 1.79/2.37 mmHg；外部 MIMIC-IV 表格约为 4.6/1.9 mmHg MAE。
conclusion_summary_zh: 表面误差很低，但论文使用每个测试 ABP 窗口自身的 μ/σ 恢复 mmHg，推理时等于借用了真实答案的信息。
takeaway_zh: 这是数据库中的严重泄露案例：数值不能代表真实 PPG-only 部署能力。
deployment_summary_zh: 按论文报告的流程无法部署，因为真实系统不知道当前 ABP 窗口的均值和标准差。
leakage_summary_zh: 严重：测试 ABP 用于逐窗反归一化，且 ABP 参与质量筛选；即使 subject-disjoint 和外部数据成立，也不能抵消目标泄露。
calibration_notes: However, each test ABP window supplies its own mean and standard deviation for denormalization, which functions as unavailable target information.
subject_split_notes: VitalDB split 1,568/328/330 subjects; overlapping windows stay within subject partitions.
external_validation_notes: External test without retraining is reported, but the same target-dependent preprocessing issue applies.
deployment_judgment: 按论文流程不可部署为 PPG-only 绝对 BP
inference_inputs: PPG | current true ABP window mean | current true ABP window standard deviation
deployment_notes: Real deployment cannot know current ABP μ/σ needed to restore mmHg.
abp_bp_denormalization: YES — per-window true ABP μ/σ stored and used for denormalization
abp_bp_alignment: not explicitly reported; synchronization source is pre-extracted paired data
abp_bp_windowing: YES — ABP peaks/troughs define labels and validity; minimum three ABP peaks required
abp_bp_quality_filtering: YES — true SBP/DBP/PP ranges and ABP peak count filter windows
target_dependent_calibration: YES in effect through per-window ABP denormalization
window_leakage: overlapping windows, but subject-wise partitions prevent cross-subject-window overlap
subject_leakage: NO according to reported subject-wise split
leakage_notes: Subject split and external data do not cancel leakage caused by current-test ABP statistics and ABP-based test selection.
notes: 本库最高优先级泄露案例。

title: Cuffless hemodynamic monitoring with physics-informed machine learning models
topics: BioZ | cuffless BP | sPINN | physics-informed ML | smartwatch
datasets: PulseDB + synthetic BioZ | 75 healthy participants | hypertension/CVD clinical cohorts | one-year pilot
input_signals: wrist BioZ resistance/reactance | space-time coordinates | optional anthropometric/anatomical metadata
model_method: BioZ signal encoder plus signal-tagged PINN constrained by Navier–Stokes/elastic-tube physics predicts BP and radial/axial velocity fields.
main_results: Cross-sectional r² ranges about 0.588–0.854 across cohorts; subject-specific models reached higher r². One-year pilot required daily recalibration to maintain performance.
study_goal_zh: 用 BioZ 和物理约束模型同时估计 BP 与血流动力学状态，并观察长期使用时是否稳定。
method_summary_zh: BioZ encoder 与 signal-tagged PINN 结合，用 Navier–Stokes 和弹性管模型约束 BP 及径向/轴向速度场。
result_summary_zh: 不同队列的横断面 r² 约 0.588–0.854，个体专属模型更高；一年 pilot 中需要每日重新校准才能维持表现。
conclusion_summary_zh: 物理约束提高了可解释性，但长期稳定性仍依赖高频校准，当前硬件续航也限制连续部署。
takeaway_zh: 是很有价值的 BioZ+sPINN 研究原型，还不是低维护、长期自主运行的设备。
deployment_summary_zh: 报告配置下连续 BLE 续航约 6 小时，长期使用还需要每日 recalibration。

title: Long-term accuracy and stability of blood pressure measurements from a smartwatch: Prospective validation study
topics: PPG | smartwatch | cuffless BP | 28-day calibration stability
input_signals: Samsung Galaxy Watch 5 PPG pipeline | stored Day-0 cuff calibration
model_method: Day-0 calibration followed by 27 days of paired Galaxy Watch 5 and Omron M4 measurements.
main_results: Overall MD about −0.34 mmHg SBP and +0.62 mmHg DBP; estimated 28-day drift −0.19/+1.02 mmHg. Error increased when actual BP moved about 10 mmHg away from the initial calibration point.
study_goal_zh: 观察 Galaxy Watch 经过一次初始校准后，连续 27 天的 BP 准确性和漂移情况。
method_summary_zh: 第 0 天校准手表，此后 27 天与 Omron M4 做成对比较；日常 Omron 读数只作为参考，不更新手表。
result_summary_zh: 总体 SBP/DBP MD 约 −0.34/+0.62 mmHg，估计 28 天漂移 −0.19/+1.02 mmHg；真实 BP 距初始校准点约 10 mmHg 时，误差明显增大。
conclusion_summary_zh: 平均漂移不大，但模型更擅长在校准点附近工作；BP 状态发生较大变化时可靠性下降。
takeaway_zh: “30 天稳定”不能只看平均偏差，还要看离开个人校准点后的误差。
deployment_summary_zh: 只需第 0 天校准，之后手表独立输出；每日 Omron 仅用于研究验证。

title: CardioState-JEPA: Delay-Aware Cross-Modal Learning of a Shared Cardiac Representation
topics: PPG | ECG | PCG | foundation model | JEPA | delay alignment
datasets: multiple unimodal and paired cardiac datasets
model_method: Two-stage joint-embedding predictive architecture with modality tokenizers, shared Transformer, masked latent prediction, and learned cross-modal delay alignment.
main_results: Frozen encoder reports +8.2 AUROC points for PPG classification, +18.8 for PCG murmur detection and +15.5 for ECG classification over the best SSL baseline.
study_goal_zh: 让 PPG、ECG、PCG 在存在生理时间延迟时仍能学习共享的 cardiac representation。
method_summary_zh: 两阶段 JEPA：各模态 tokenizer、共享 Transformer、masked latent prediction，加上可学习的跨模态 delay alignment。
result_summary_zh: 冻结 encoder 后，相比最佳 SSL baseline，PPG 分类、PCG murmur 检测和 ECG 分类分别提高 8.2、18.8、15.5 个 AUROC 点。
conclusion_summary_zh: 延迟感知的跨模态预训练能提升通用心血管表征，但论文并未直接验证无袖带 BP head。
takeaway_zh: 可作为下游模型底座，不能把多任务 AUROC 提升等同于 BP 精度提升。
deployment_summary_zh: 跨模态 delay aligner 在预训练阶段学习；具体下游可仅保留目标模态，但 BP 任务需另做验证。
leakage_summary_zh: 共享表征本身不是 BP 泄露；风险取决于下游 BP 标签、时间对齐和受试者划分。

conclusion_summary_zh: 数据完整性和同步质量可能比更复杂的网络更重要；少量校准有效，但不能解决 SBP 的全部问题。

title: Change Point–Aware Evaluation and Re-Calibration of PPG-Based Blood Pressure Estimation
topics: PPG | cuffless BP | change point | recalibration | evaluation
input_signals: PPG | BP trajectory for change-point evaluation
model_method: Detects distributional change points in BP trajectories, evaluates models around fluctuations, and triggers targeted recalibration.
main_results: Shows substantial model degradation near BP change points; periodic calibration is insufficient, while change-point-triggered recalibration improves robustness (exact values pending table extraction).
study_goal_zh: 研究 BP 分布突然变化时 PPG→BP 模型为什么失效，以及何时应该重新校准。
method_summary_zh: 检测 BP trajectory 的 change point，分别评估变化点前后误差，并在检测到变化时触发 targeted recalibration。
result_summary_zh: 模型在 BP change point 附近明显退化；固定周期校准不足，变化点触发的重新校准更稳健。具体数值仍待表格复核。
conclusion_summary_zh: 校准应与生理状态变化关联，而不只是按固定天数执行；但触发器不能依赖部署时不可得的真实 BP。

title: Domain-independent PPG signal quality assessment framework via representation learning
topics: PPG | signal quality | representation learning | domain generalization
datasets: CSL finger PPG | WCS wrist PPG | AA neck PPG
model_method: Fine-tunes a pretrained PPG Transformer with triplet loss; quality is embedding distance to high-quality reference embeddings.
main_results: Approximate F1: 90% finger, 95% wrist with generalized references, 70% neck.
study_goal_zh: 建立跨部位、跨设备更稳健的 PPG signal quality assessment，先识别坏信号再进入 BP 或其他下游模型。
method_summary_zh: 用 triplet loss 微调预训练 PPG Transformer，以待测片段到高质量 reference embedding 的距离判断质量。
result_summary_zh: F1 约为手指 90%、手腕 95%、颈部 70%；跨域效果因采集部位而异。
conclusion_summary_zh: SQA 可实时运行且不依赖 BP 标签，适合作为部署前端；颈部等新域仍需更多数据。
takeaway_zh: 先判断 PPG 能不能用，再估 BP；这是减少运动伪影失败的实用组件。
deployment_summary_zh: 推理仅需 PPG 和已保存的高质量 reference embedding，不需要当前 BP。
leakage_summary_zh: 未使用 BP 目标做质量筛选，目标泄露风险低；应继续避免同一受试者片段跨训练/测试。

subject_split_notes: Exact subject partition details need table-level audit.
deployment_judgment: 适合作为 BP 模型前置 SQA
deployment_notes: Real-time compatible; no BP target needed.
abp_bp_quality_filtering: PPG morphology/expert quality labels, not BP values

title: Large-scale bilateral cardiovascular monitoring via wearable rings
topics: PPG | ring | bilateral | cuffless BP | benchmark
input_signals: left ring PPG | right ring PPG
model_method: Twelve backbones benchmark bilateral and averaged ring-PPG prediction across cardiovascular/demographic targets.
main_results: 97,559 valid samples from 1,810 participants; bilateral SBP/DBP MAE 12.36/8.21 mmHg, only modestly better than cohort-mean baselines 13.81/9.27.
study_goal_zh: 检验左右手双 ring PPG 是否比单侧信号更适合预测 BP 等心血管和人口学指标。
method_summary_zh: 在 12 种 backbone 上比较左手、右手、双侧融合和平均 ring PPG 的多目标预测。
result_summary_zh: 1,810 人、97,559 个有效样本；双侧 SBP/DBP MAE 为 12.36/8.21 mmHg，只比人群均值 baseline 13.81/9.27 略好。
conclusion_summary_zh: 双侧信号有一定增益，但绝对 BP 误差仍大，且双 ring 的硬件成本并未换来决定性提升。
takeaway_zh: 更适合作为左右差异和姿势研究资源，不宜宣传为高精度 BP 方案。
deployment_summary_zh: 需要两枚 ring，是额外佩戴成本；当前 BP 精度不足以支撑产品结论。
leakage_summary_zh: 必须按参与者划分；若把同一人的左右手或不同 session 分到训练和测试，会显著高估泛化。
calibration_notes: Population benchmark.
subject_split_notes: Do not assume session-level split is safe.
deployment_judgment: HR 价值较强，绝对 BP 价值有限
deployment_notes: Two-ring requirement is itself a deployment cost.
leakage_notes: Transparent weak BP result is more credible than near-zero MAE under unsafe splits.
notes: 重点深审。

title: Evaluation of Alysis-001 cuffless blood pressure estimation algorithm against the European Society of Hypertension awake/asleep test criteria in hypertensive patients
topics: cuffless BP | wearable | clinical validation | ESH awake/asleep | calibration-free
datasets: independent development cohorts: 953 seated-rest + 150 treadmill | prospective 24 h hypertensive cohort
input_signals: green/red/IR PPG | electro-potential pulse signal | accelerometer | gyroscope | skin temperature | age | height | weight
model_method: Biomechanical Moens–Korteweg-based multiparametric algorithm estimates velocity, volume and arterial elasticity; motion/posture correction and signal-quality rejection are applied.
main_results: 92 enrolled, 78 analyzed; passed all ESH awake/asleep criteria under both extraction strategies; ICC >0.70, non-dipper sensitivity 0.93, specificity 0.75, accuracy 0.82.
study_goal_zh: 在高血压门诊人群中检验 Alysis-001 的 24 小时 awake/asleep BP 表现和 non-dipper 识别能力。
method_summary_zh: 基于 Moens–Korteweg 的多参数生物力学算法估计血流速度、容量和动脉弹性，并结合多光谱 PPG、electro-potential、IMU、温度与人口学信息做运动/姿势校正和 SQA。
result_summary_zh: 92 人入组、78 人纳入分析；两种提取策略都通过 ESH awake/asleep 条件，ICC>0.70；non-dipper sensitivity 0.93、specificity 0.75、accuracy 0.82。
conclusion_summary_zh: 这是较强的真实 24 h wearable 证据，且无需 cuff 校准；但通过 awake/asleep 主测试不等于完成全部 cuffless device 验证。
takeaway_zh: 在当前库中属于部署证据较强的一项，但结论范围应严格限定在研究完成的测试上。
deployment_summary_zh: 推理需要多光谱 PPG、electro-potential、IMU、温度和人口学信息；高强度活动会自动拒测。
leakage_summary_zh: 独立前瞻性队列，参考 ABPM 只用于比较；未发现用参考 BP 反归一化、选 beat 或做内部 SQA。
calibration_notes: Uses age, height and weight; no initial or periodic cuff calibration.
subject_split_notes: Evaluation cohort has no overlap with independent development datasets.
external_validation_notes: Reference ABPM every 30 min; ESH awake/asleep primary test, not the entire cuffless-device validation suite.
inference_inputs: multispectral PPG | electro-potential | IMU | temperature | demographics
deployment_notes: Automatically rejects high-intensity activity; does not require cuff calibration.
abp_bp_alignment: 30-min aggregation used for comparison, not to generate individual estimates
abp_bp_windowing: wearable uses fixed 10 s cycles; reference ABPM does not select beats

window_leakage: not applicable to independent prospective cohort
leakage_notes: Reference ABPM is used for validation, not fed into Alysis estimates.

title: A Multi-posture Asymmetry-aware Intelligent Bilateral Observation Dataset for Cardiovascular Monitoring
topics: PPG | dataset | ring | bilateral | posture | cuffless BP
input_signals: left ring PPG | right ring PPG | posture | age | sex | BMI
model_method: Dataset descriptor: synchronized bilateral ring PPG across three standardized postures with SBP/DBP/HR and demographic labels.
main_results: 1,810 participants and 7,478 sessions; designed for bilateral and posture-dependent cardiovascular benchmarking.
study_goal_zh: 发布一个同时包含左右手 ring PPG 和多种体位的 BP 数据集，用于研究侧别与姿势造成的 domain shift。
method_summary_zh: 同步采集左右手 ring PPG，覆盖 3 种标准体位，并提供 SBP/DBP/HR、年龄、性别、BMI 等标签。
result_summary_zh: MAIBO 包含 1,810 名参与者和 7,478 个 session，适合做左右手与姿势依赖的心血管 benchmark。
conclusion_summary_zh: 数据集非常贴近 wearable 研究，但它不会自动保证安全划分；使用者必须自己按 participant ID 分组。
takeaway_zh: 最有价值的实验是 left→right、supine→sitting/standing，而不是随机 window split。
deployment_summary_zh: 下游推理可只用 ring PPG，也可加入设备实际可得的 posture/IMU。
leakage_summary_zh: 数据构建未见当前 BP 反归一化；最大风险是把同一人的不同手、体位或 session 随机分到训练和测试。

subject_split_notes: Dataset users must split by participant ID; random session/window split is unsafe.
external_validation_notes: Dataset resource, not an externally validated estimator.
deployment_notes: Suitable for left→right and posture-shift tests.
leakage_risk: low at dataset construction / high if mis-split
abp_bp_alignment: reference labels synchronized at session level
abp_bp_quality_filtering: dataset QC present; no current-BP inverse scaling found
leakage_notes: Dataset does not guarantee safe downstream splitting by itself.

title: HealthRing: Physiology Dataset for Health Sensing on Rings
topics: PPG | dataset | ring | motion artifact | wearable | cuffless BP
input_signals: reflective red/IR PPG | transmissive red/IR PPG | 3-axis accelerometer
model_method: Three synchronized cohorts: controlled stimuli, semi-free-living activities and treadmill running; RingTool provides signal-processing and DL baselines.
main_results: 54 adults; controlled+daily benchmarks: SBP/DBP MAE 12.98/7.64 mmHg, HR 5.33 bpm, RR 2.98 breaths/min, SpO2 1.72%.
study_goal_zh: 提供包含真实运动伪影的 ring physiology 数据，让算法不只在静坐实验中评估。
method_summary_zh: 采集 controlled stimuli、semi-free-living 日常活动和 treadmill running 三组同步数据；两枚 ring 记录反射/透射 red/IR PPG 与 3-axis accelerometer。
result_summary_zh: 共 54 名成人；controlled+daily benchmark 的 SBP/DBP MAE 为 12.98/7.64 mmHg，HR 5.33 bpm，RR 2.98 次/分，SpO₂ 1.72%。
conclusion_summary_zh: HealthRing 对运动鲁棒性和拒测策略很有价值，但当前 BP benchmark 精度有限，不能视作消费设备验证。
takeaway_zh: 适合研究 arm swing 下“何时不该输出”，而不是证明 ring 已能准确测 BP。
deployment_summary_zh: 推理输入是 ring PPG 与 accelerometer；可用于运动场景下的 SQA 和鲁棒性研究。
leakage_summary_zh: 数据本身不要求目标依赖处理；复用时必须按 subject 分组，不能随机打散高度重叠的 windows。
calibration_notes: Dataset paper does not establish a product calibration protocol.
subject_split_notes: Downstream users must preserve subject separation.
external_validation_notes: Motion cohort tests transfer, but BP benchmark is mainly controlled/daily.

deployment_notes: Supports rejection/robustness research under arm swing.

title: Causal Decomposition of PPG Signals for Cuffless Blood Pressure Estimation
topics: PPG | cuffless BP | EEMD | causal inference | interpretability
model_method: EEMD decomposes PPG into IMFs; counterfactual exclusion and structural causal modeling select BP-relevant components; CNN/GBRT/PAT baselines are compared.
main_results: IMF4–6 showed strongest causal association; CNN using IMF4+5 achieved SBP/DBP MAE 5.55/3.45 mmHg, improving 26.39%/17.86% over original PPG.
study_goal_zh: 找出 PPG 中与 BP 更有因果关联的频率成分，而不是直接把整段波形交给黑箱模型。
method_summary_zh: 用 EEMD 把 PPG 分解为多个 IMF，再通过 counterfactual exclusion 和 structural causal modeling 选择 BP 相关分量，并比较 CNN、GBRT、PAT。
result_summary_zh: IMF4–6 的因果关联最强；CNN 使用 IMF4+5 时，SBP/DBP MAE 为 5.55/3.45 mmHg，比原始 PPG 改善 26.39%/17.86%。
conclusion_summary_zh: 选择生理相关分量能改善模型，但“causal”命名不能替代 subject-disjoint 和 external validation。
takeaway_zh: 解释性方向值得跟进，当前证据仍不足以证明跨数据集和实时部署稳定。
deployment_summary_zh: 推理可 PPG-only，但需要固定 EEMD/分量选择流程；实时计算成本与跨域稳定性尚未解决。
leakage_summary_zh: 摘要未报告明显目标反归一化；subject split、切窗和外部验证仍需全文审计。

title: A Revised Point-to-Point Calibration Approach with Adaptive Errors Correction to Weaken Initial Sensitivity of Cuff-Less Blood Pressure Estimation
topics: cuffless BP | PTT | calibration | adaptive correction
model_method: Compares original one-point PTP calibration with mean PTP (mPTP) and penalty-factor adaptive PTP (fPTP) correction across exercise intensities.
main_results: mPTP and fPTP reduce sensitivity to a single initial calm-state sample and improve consistency relative to oPTP; exact metrics retained in source paper.
study_goal_zh: 降低 PTT 类无袖带 BP 模型对单个初始校准点的敏感性，让运动状态变化时更稳定。
method_summary_zh: 比较原始 one-point PTP、多个静息点取平均的 mPTP，以及加入 penalty factor 动态修正的 fPTP。
result_summary_zh: mPTP 和 fPTP 相比 oPTP 减少了对单个静息样本的依赖，并提高不同运动强度下的一致性；具体数值保留在原文中。
conclusion_summary_zh: 多点或自适应校准比单点更稳，但它仍是校准型方法，不是 calibration-free BP。
takeaway_zh: 适合作为校准策略 baseline；必须确认实时 correction 不会使用部署时拿不到的当前参考 BP。
deployment_summary_zh: 推理需要 ECG/PPG-derived PTT 和个人参数；自适应更新的可用输入必须重新审计。
leakage_summary_zh: 历史 BP 用于校准是明确的；若 fPTP 在测试时使用同时刻参考 BP 更新参数，就会形成目标依赖。
